overall_notes: The paper focuses on controlled text generation with rhetorical directives. The metadata extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization for consistency. The paper uses both automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, etc.) and extensive human evaluation including both crowdsourcing and interactive user studies. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted despite using GPT-2 for generation.
